plugins.cameraPermission: Xapp needs the camera so you can show your load to drivers.
plugins.photosPermission: Xapp needs your photos so you can show your load to drivers.

plugins.microphonePermission: Xapp needs the microphone so you can record a voice note for the driver.
Xapp needs the microphone so you can talk: your words are written for you and kept as a voice note for the driver.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Xapp turns what you say into text to fill in your request.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Xapp uses your location to show where you are and set the pickup point.
